articles.title: CleoPtolemy made with Midjourney
articles.author: Vineet Vijay
articles.content: CleoPtolemy made with Midjourney Most teams building retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems for high stakes classification make the same architectural bet: Route every ambiguous case straight to the language model and trust the retrieved context to sort it out. This works fine in a demo. It falls apart the moment the system has to survive an audit, a regulator, or a compliance officer asking why a specific decision was made six months ago.
headings: Cutting RAG inference costs 6x starts with deciding what never reaches the LLM

articles.title: Credit: VentureBeat made with Midjourney
articles.author: Michael Nuñez
articles.content: Credit: VentureBeat made with Midjourney The headline numbers are striking: Writer says its agent product now operates at an average 52% lower cost, with a 48% improvement in speed and a 10% improvement in quality when paired with Palmyra X6. But the more consequential story may be how the company got there — and what its choices reveal about where the enterprise AI market is heading.
headings: Writer says its new Palmyra X6 model cuts AI agent costs by 52% as token spending surges
